conclusion.rationale: Testing is blocked due to missing build dependencies (intltool for autogen.sh, libsoup-2.4-dev for linking). The static analysis identified 2 compatibility changes (PCA-0001 HIGH: conditional Authorization header removal, PCA-0002 MEDIUM: append-to-replace semantic change). Both are SIDE_EFFECT_CHANGE in the auth manager's HTTP header handling. Without being able to build and instrument the library, we cannot execute contract verification or measure patch-line coverage. The generated test artifacts (reproducer.sh + harness.c) are structurally complete and ready to execute once dependencies are installed.
